orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Lumen "Ion Drive: Corona", a hull mount (outward is up): the Halo spine and ring of light, with the outriggers replaced by crystal fins (cyan facets, a white tip, magenta pins) that fan out from the base; inside the Halo core with a crown of crystal spikes round the lens. Damaged: the middle ring has slipped and cracked, a crystal fin is snapped half off, arcs jump the gap, the lens is cracked and flickers. Disabled: the top ring snapped half off, both fin clusters broken and dark, the halo ring dead, the lens shattered. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
